english.title: Provide false / misleading info under reg 7(1)(b) of the Nutrition and Health Claims (England) Regulations 2007

english.notes: As of 01/10/2024 this offence is no longer in use. Regulation 7 was repealed by reg 2(5) of SI 2024/165.

other.penalty:
Summary: Three months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale.
Indictment: Two years Imprisonment and / or a fine

Time Limit for Prosecutions:
Complex - three years from the commission of the offence or one year from its discovery by the prosecutor, whichever is the earlier

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
